# mxroute_quota (Data Source)

Read account reporting. Values refresh hourly upstream, may be stale, and are computed only; they never cause configuration writes. All results are scoped to the provider's effective account. Unavailable/malformed values are errors, never invented zero values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_quota" "account" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `breakdown` (Attributes) Storage category breakdown in bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--breakdown))
- `grace_period` (Attributes) Nullable grace period for an over-quota account; null is preserved and clears previous state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grace_period))
- `percent_used` (Number) API-reported percentage; preserved without recomputing unlimited semantics.
- `total_limit` (Number) Account storage limit; zero means unlimited. Unit: bytes, with no MB/GB conversion.
- `total_used` (Number) Total storage consumed. Unit: bytes, with no MB/GB conversion.
- `updated_at` (String) Upstream date-time of the hourly snapshot, preserved exactly including timezone.
- `username` (String) Server-reported effective account username.

<a id="nestedatt--breakdown"></a>
### Nested Schema for `breakdown`

Read-Only:

- `backups` (Number) Category storage consumed. Unit: bytes, with no MB/GB conversion.

- `email` (Number) Category storage consumed. Unit: bytes, with no MB/GB conversion.
- `other` (Number) Category storage consumed. Unit: bytes, with no MB/GB conversion.
- `web` (Number) Category storage consumed. Unit: bytes, with no MB/GB conversion.


<a id="nestedatt--grace_period"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grace_period`

Read-Only:

- `deadline` (String) Server-provided deadline string, preserved exactly.
